thread:
maria: Heads-up — seeing recurring 99th-token latency spikes in eu-west shared pool during the nightly batch window (around 02:00 UTC). Tail correlates with rack12 telemetry: NVLINK RX errors + sustained PCIe DMA.

raj: saw a matching alert earlier. Could be noisy neighbor from a few heavy training/batch tenants. Any tenant names?

sophie: tracing shows heavy DMA bursts from tenant:synth-labs on slot-3 of rack12. Also egress queue saturation (~95%) during the spike.

maria: thanks. Two low-friction mitigations to consider: 1) move high-throughput gen jobs to soft-iso lanes (fractional dedicated carve) for the window; 2) apply nic eBPF policing on offending tenant to cap DMA bursts. Tradeoffs: cost vs. throughput risk.

ellis: cost ballpark for soft-iso: reserving 4 gpus for 6h in eu-west ~= ~$420 (back-of-envelope) — cheaper than 24/7 dedicate but non-trivial. Throttle route is cheaper but may increase client retry latencies.

jack: also consider routing by shape tag (gen-heavy -> prefer:soft-iso) so we don't shift unrelated workloads.

ops-bot: alert: rack12 nvlink_rx_overflow +38% in last 30m; egress_queue_high on host rack12-node-07.

sophie: quick probe I ran:
```
# list pods with high NIC tx in last 10m
curl -s http://telemetry.internal/hosts/rack12/top-tx | jq . | head
# sample alloc trace
curl -s http://allocs.internal/trace?shelf=rack12&window=10m
```

maria: decision proposal — tonight 00:00-06:00 UTC run a canary: carve soft-iso lanes (4 gpus) and route gen-high tenants there. Measure client.latency.99 and token-cost delta. If 99th drops >30% and cost delta <2x, we keep nightly hedge.

ellis: I will raise a quick finance note and put a provisional budget on the run. Filing INFRA-5421 for cost approval and tracking.

raj: I'll push a routing rule flag 'prefer:soft_iso' to the allocator canary branch and add instrumentation: client.latency.99.soft_iso_vs_shared and egress.queue_pct. Will also tag synth-labs traffic for one night.

sophie: I'll add an automated rollback if packet drops or NVLINK errors spike >10% over baseline.

jack: alternative play if finance says no — enable nic-policing eBPF on synth-labs for the window and throttle DMA bursts to 60% peak. Less cost, more risk.

maria: agreed. Action items: ellis -> finance note/Jira, raj -> routing canary and metrics, sophie -> rollback guard, jack -> eBPF throttle plan (standby). We'll reconvene 23:00 UTC to validate flags. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket INFRA-5421 created by ellis at 1733333050.
